stage.name: South Prison
stage.description:
The convict Jesselton, having been transferred from Mansfield State Prison, has incited a prison riot, aided by the local Siracusan gangs who decided to join in. Rhodes Island must intervene immediately and put down the insurrection using the Imprisonment Devices. 
<Special Conditions>DP will not regenerate naturally.
<Imprisonment Device>Imprisons freed enemies within its effect area.

elite_sniper_prisoner.name: Elite Sniper Prisoner
elite_sniper_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate experienced at using handmade ranged weapons. Though far from a master in Originium Arts, his arrows are already extremely dangerous.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and now deals Arts damage
Prioritizes attacking Imprisonment Devices

hound_pro.name: Hound Pro
hound_pro.flavourText: A creature controlled by a Reunion recon squad that is more dangerous than a normal Hound. Monitoring equipment is strapped to its body. Due to their speed and evasiveness, they can easily slip through enemy defenses and cause heavy damage.

seasoned_prisoner.name: Seasoned Prisoner
seasoned_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate deeply familiar with the laws of survival of Mansfield State Prison. Will utilize his accumulated experience to outsmart you and is difficult to deal with.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK

sicilian.name: Sicilian
sicilian.flavourText: A basic melee combatant. These Siracusans adorn themselves with an ancient name, symbolizing the glory of an era bygone.

sniper_prisoner.name: Sniper Prisoner
sniper_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate who cobbled together a ranged weapon to avoid getting into brawls. Knows a little about Originium Arts and can strengthen his 'arrows'.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and now deals Arts damage
Prioritizes attacking Imprisonment Devices

ordinary_prisoner.name: Ordinary Prisoner
ordinary_prisoner.flavourText: A commonly seen prisoner of Mansfield State Prison. Even so, don't let your guard down or he'll slip past you.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK

elite_sicilian.name: Elite Sicilian
elite_sicilian.flavourText: A basic melee combatant with higher combat capabilities than a normal Sicilian. These Siracusans adorn themselves with an ancient name, symbolizing the glory of an era bygone.

strongman_prisoner.name: Strongman Prisoner
strongman_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate with great strength. The weapons in his hands seem to have been acquired from ransacking a storage room. During a melee, will often rush to the frontline and inflict great damage.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and RES and regenerates HP over time

deadly_caster_prisoner.name: Deadly Caster Prisoner
deadly_caster_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate with a weak constitution. Due to being unable to overcome his bindings on his own, he's instead learned to utilize defensive techniques using the devices on his body. On the other hand, he's extremely well-versed in Originium Arts and will become very difficult to deal with should he be freed.
abilities: All enemies gain significantly increased ASPD when on the field
Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, does not attack but gains increased DEF
After being freed, attacks 2 enemies simultaneously and prioritizes attacking Imprisonment Devices

caster_prisoner.name: Caster Prisoner
caster_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate with a weak constitution. Due to being unable to overcome his bindings on his own, he's instead learned to utilize defensive techniques using the devices on his body. On the other hand, he's well-versed in Originium Arts and will become very difficult to deal with should he be freed.
abilities: All enemies gain increased ASPD when on the field
Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, does not attack but gains increased DEF
After being freed, attacks 2 enemies simultaneously and prioritizes attacking Imprisonment Devices

pugilist_prisoner.name: Pugilist Prisoner
pugilist_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate who puts his trust in his fists. ——In reality, the metal chains on his wrists are doing most of the work.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and attacks ignore a certain portion of the target's DEF

herculean_prisoner.name: Herculean Prisoner
herculean_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate with immense strength. The weapons in his hands seem to have been acquired from ransacking a storage room. During a melee, will often rush to the frontline and inflict great damage.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and RES and regenerates HP over time

infamous_recidivist.name: Infamous Recidivist
infamous_recidivist.flavourText: A legendary prisoner whose might is second only to that of Anthony. Has learned patience after his long stay in prison, and pays no attention to normal attacks and provocations. However, avoid enraging him at all costs, or be prepared to face the consequences.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced but gains increased DEF
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK
When freed for the first time, immediately frees all other enemies

recidivist.name: Recidivist
recidivist.flavourText: A vicious inmate feared by inmates and guards alike. Has learned patience after his long stay in prison, and pays no attention to normal attacks and provocations. However, avoid enraging him at all costs, or be prepared to face the consequences.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced but gains increased DEF
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK
When freed for the first time, immediately frees all other enemies

elite_pugilist_prisoner.name: Elite Pugilist Prisoner
elite_pugilist_prisoner.flavourText: An inmate who wholeheartedly trusts in his fists. Do not underestimate this inmate who is able to utilize both fist and chain in harmony now.
abilities: Starts imprisoned. When imprisoned, ASPD is reduced
Freed after a few attacks, gaining increased ATK and attacks ignore a certain portion of the target's DEF

jesselton_williams.name: Jesselton Williams
jesselton_williams.flavourText: Jesselton Williams, a killer who infiltrated the prison disguised as a jailer. Very particular in both speech and action, he remains graceful even in the midst of battle.
abilities: Jailer Form
RES is greatly increased
Attacks become ranged and deal Arts damage, and no longer attacks Imprisonment Devices
Can Stun multiple targets
The first time HP drops to 0, enters Killer Form
Killer Form
Frees all imprisoned enemies when entering Killer Form
Gains significantly increased DEF
Uses melee Physical attacks that ignore a certain amount of the target's DEF
